Nora (CS): Vela onboarding check-in: p50 240ms, p95 1.05s, token cost ~2.0x. Customer: "answers are accurate but booking flow stalls." Renewal in 38d. Low-risk perf levers to propose?
Arjun (ML Eng): Recommend a short canary: 10% q4 (int4) + a 15% redwood-v2-small experiment. Run eval on their seed prompts first.
Priya (Solutions): Vela runs in us-west-2, mostly A10g. They have many short dialogs (<=256 tokens). Any special notes?
Leo (Infra): For short dialogs, q4 gives good latency wins. Ops note: run a KV warmup replay and a brief mem bump during rollout to avoid p95 spikes.
Arjun (ML Eng): Example routing snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: customer_id == "vela"
    traffic_split:
      redwood-v2-base: 75
      redwood-v2-base-q4: 10
      redwood-v2-small: 15
    rollout_window: 48h
    metrics: ["p95_latency_ms","error_rate","quality_delta"]
```
Sam (AE): Customer's ask: get p95 <750ms to feel comfortable. I'll flag in renewal notes.
Ethan (Observability): I'll create a canary dashboard + alerts. Proposed auto-rollback if error_rate >1% or quality_delta >2%. Will also run synthetic warmup traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-06-12T10:00:00Z at 10% q4 + 15% small. Health checks: p95, errors, quality_delta. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/vela-3345678901
Nora (CS): Plan: 1) Run eval on vela_prompts 2) Launch 10% q4 + 15% small with warmup 3) Monitor p95/errors/quality_delta 4) Ramp if stable. Priya/Sam: customer comms. Arjun/Leo/Ethan: ops + rollback. Agree?
Priya (Solutions): Agree. I'll draft the technical note and share it.
Arjun (ML Eng): Starting eval & q4 build now.
Leo (Infra): Scheduling warmup job 20m pre-rollout.
Ethan (Observability): Dashboard created, will paste link here when ready.
